userStories.title: Project Setup & Supabase Integration
acceptanceCriteria: Xcode project created with SwiftUI lifecycle
supabase-swift SDK integrated via Swift Package Manager
SupabaseClient singleton configured with project URL and anon key
All data models created (Movie, Category, Nomination, etc.)
App builds successfully on iOS 17+ simulator
userStories.notes: Foundation phase - must complete before other features

userStories.title: Design System Implementation
acceptanceCriteria: Color+Extensions.swift with all theme colors (gold, background, text)
Font+Extensions.swift with display and body font styles
GlassCard component with blur and border effects
GoldButtonStyle with gradient and press animation
userStories.notes: Required for consistent UI across all screens

userStories.title: User Authentication - Login
acceptanceCriteria: LoginView with email and password fields
Sign In button triggers Supabase auth
Error messages displayed for invalid credentials

userStories.title: User Authentication - Sign Up
acceptanceCriteria: SignUpView with email and password fields
Sign Up button creates Supabase user

userStories.title: User Authentication - Google OAuth
acceptanceCriteria: Continue with Google button on login/signup screens
Existing Google users navigate to Dashboard

userStories.title: User Onboarding - Username Setup
acceptanceCriteria: OnboardingView presented as sheet for new users
Continue button dismisses sheet and shows Dashboard

userStories.title: Tab Navigation Structure
acceptanceCriteria: TabView with 5 tabs: Dashboard, Watch Plan, Ballot, Leaderboard, More
SF Symbol icons for each tab
More tab shows menu with Groups and Profile options
iPad uses sidebar navigation instead of tab bar
Navigation state persists across tab switches

userStories.title: Dashboard - Progress Hero
acceptanceCriteria: ProgressHeroView displays watched count and total
Gold gradient progress bar shows completion
Movies per day calculation shown (days until March 15)
Glass card styling with radial gradient background

userStories.title: Dashboard - Movie Grid (Master List)
acceptanceCriteria: 2 columns on iPhone, 4-5 columns on iPad

userStories.title: Dashboard - Toggle Watched
acceptanceCriteria: Tap movie card toggles watched status

userStories.title: Dashboard - Category List View
acceptanceCriteria: Segmented picker to switch between Master List and By Category
CategoryListView groups movies by award category
Movies under each category with watch toggle
Same movie can appear in multiple categories

userStories.title: Watch Plan - Date Grouped List
acceptanceCriteria: WatchPlanView shows movies grouped by planned date
Date headers formatted as 'TODAY', 'TOMORROW', or date string
Overdue section at top with red styling
Each movie row shows poster, title, runtime, year
Missed badge shown for overdue movies
Stats shown: planned count, unplanned count, watched count

userStories.title: Watch Plan - Add Movie to Plan
acceptanceCriteria: Sheet shows list of unwatched movies not yet in plan
Date picker for selecting planned date
Add button inserts to watch_plan table
New movie appears in correct date group

userStories.title: Watch Plan - Reschedule Movie
acceptanceCriteria: Move button on each movie card
Selecting new date updates watch_plan table
Movie moves to new date group with animation

userStories.title: Watch Plan - Mark Watched & Remove
acceptanceCriteria: Watched button marks movie as watched
Updates both user_watched and watch_plan tables
X button removes from plan without marking watched

userStories.title: Watch Plan - Drag and Drop
acceptanceCriteria: Long press (200ms) initiates drag on touch devices
Drag movie between date groups to reschedule
Visual feedback during drag (rotation, scale, shadow)
Drop target highlights when dragging over

userStories.title: Watch Plan - Auto Scheduler
acceptanceCriteria: User can select movies to schedule
Algorithm suggests dates to fill gaps
Confirm button bulk inserts to watch_plan

userStories.title: Watch Plan - What Can I Watch
acceptanceCriteria: What Can I Watch button in toolbar
Quick add to plan from filtered list

userStories.title: Ballot - Category List
acceptanceCriteria: Categories sorted by points value (highest first)
CategoryCard shows category name and points
Each card expandable to show nominations

userStories.title: Ballot - Make Predictions
acceptanceCriteria: Radio button style selection in each category
Only one nomination selectable per category

userStories.title: Ballot - Progress Indicator
acceptanceCriteria: Updates in real-time as predictions are made

userStories.title: Ballot - Countdown Timer
acceptanceCriteria: CountdownTimerView shows time until ballot locks
When time expires, ballot becomes locked

userStories.title: Ballot - Winner Display
acceptanceCriteria: Winner badge shown on winning nomination

userStories.title: Leaderboard - Global Rankings
acceptanceCriteria: Users sorted by prediction score (rank field)
Top 3 users shown with medal styling (gold, silver, bronze)
Each row shows rank, username, score
Each row shows watched count and correct predictions

userStories.title: Leaderboard - Current User Highlight
acceptanceCriteria: Current user's row highlighted with gold border
Star icon next to current user
Scroll position shows current user if off-screen

userStories.title: Groups - View My Groups
acceptanceCriteria: GroupsView shows two sections: My Groups and Joined Groups
My Groups shows groups where created_by matches user
Each group card shows name, invite code, member count
Copy button copies invite code to clipboard
Tap group navigates to group leaderboard

userStories.title: Groups - Create Group
acceptanceCriteria: New group appears in My Groups

userStories.title: Groups - Join Group
acceptanceCriteria: Text field for entering invite code
Error shown if already a member
Joined group appears in Joined Groups section

userStories.title: Profile - View Profile
acceptanceCriteria: Account section with Change Password, Sign Out, Delete Account

userStories.title: Profile - Edit Username
acceptanceCriteria: Tap Edit enables inline username editing
Validation prevents empty or invalid usernames

userStories.title: Profile - Sign Out
acceptanceCriteria: Sign Out row triggers confirmation alert
Confirmed sign out clears Supabase session

userStories.title: Profile - Delete Account
acceptanceCriteria: Destructive confirmation alert with warning text
Cascades deletion of all user data
Signs out and navigates to Login

userStories.title: Haptic Feedback System
acceptanceCriteria: Light impact for toggles and selections

userStories.title: Loading States
acceptanceCriteria: Skeleton views shown while data loads
Each screen shows appropriate loading state

userStories.title: Empty States
acceptanceCriteria: Empty state for Watch Plan (no movies planned)
Each empty state has icon, title, subtitle
Call to action button where appropriate

userStories.title: iPad Layout Optimization
acceptanceCriteria: Sidebar navigation instead of tab bar on iPad
Sheets presented as popovers where appropriate

userStories.title: Accessibility
acceptanceCriteria: VoiceOver labels on all interactive elements
Dynamic Type support for text scaling

userStories.title: App Icon & Launch Screen
acceptanceCriteria: App icon designed with Oscar theme
All icon sizes generated for App Store
Launch screen matches app background color
Smooth transition from launch to app
